faqs: What is the TONTON Pro Snake-Scale MMA Fight Short?

It is a custom MMA and No-Gi grappling shorts development reference with a scale-pattern shell, hook-and-loop fly, internal drawcord, stretch crotch gusset and curved side openings. Buyers can develop their own colors, logo positions, sizing and labels.
Which colors and SKUs are available as references?

Stealth Black: TT-MMA-SS01-BLK; Tactical Grey: TT-MMA-SS01-GRY; Frost White: TT-MMA-SS01-WHT; Midnight Navy: TT-MMA-SS01-NVY. These website reference SKUs identify color options, not ready-stock inventory. Grey currently has detail photographs rather than a complete front view.
What are the shell and gusset materials?

The supplied brief specifies a 100% micro-polyester shell and an 88% polyester / 12% spandex stretch-knit gusset. Confirm exact GSM, material records and performance on the selected sample before bulk production.
Is the snake-scale effect jacquard or sublimation?

The photographs establish the visible scale-like pattern. They do not determine whether it is jacquard, sublimation or another finish. Approve the chosen material and decoration process with a swatch and sample.
Can these shorts be used for MMA or No-Gi BJJ competition?
Review the actual garment against the organizer’s current equipment rules, including pockets, hardware, exposed hook-and-loop and drawcords. This product page does not certify competition approval.
Are the waistband and seams guaranteed never to slip or tear?
No measured test is supplied for absolute non-slip, tear-proof or lifetime durability claims. Check closure security, elastic recovery, seam strength and mobility with a physical fit sample.
Can a private-label brand customize the design?
Yes. Discuss colors, scale artwork, waist tab, leg emblem, inner labels, pattern dimensions and packaging. Confirm artwork permissions and the final construction before quotation.
How do MOQ, mixed sizes and sampling work?

Selected custom projects start at 10 pieces; minimums per style, design and colorway require confirmation. Send a size allocation and measurement chart. The advertised 3–7 day sample target starts after artwork and details are confirmed; material sourcing, patterns and revisions may extend it.
